name: Ornan
overview: The Scripture presents Ornan, also called Araunah, as a Jebusite whose threshing floor became the site where King David was instructed to build an altar to the LORD to halt a devastating plague. When David approached Araunah to purchase the threshing floor, Araunah respectfully bowed before the king, offering the site willingly for the altar. This narrative highlights God's mercy in restraining judgment and David's obedience to God's command to make atonement through sacrifice at a place associated with Araunah the Jebusite.
